## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (6)
- `GET /api/v4/captcha/challenge` — Request a CAPTCHA challenge for authentication.
- `GET /api/v4/user/iam/dash-authz-eval-roles` — Evaluate user roles for dashboard authorization.
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/consent/{consentId}/{consentId}/en.json` — Authorize and retrieve OneTrust consent data (English).
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/consent/{consentId}/{consentToken}` — Authorize and retrieve OneTrust consent data.
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/scripttemplates/202510.2.0/assets/otFlat.json` — Authorize and retrieve OneTrust script template assets.
- `GET /static/vendor/onetrust/{onetrustToken}/scripttemplates/202510.2.0/assets/v2/otPcTab.json` — Authorize and retrieve OneTrust script template assets.

### Data Read (7)
- `GET /api/v4/persistence/user` — Retrieve user persistence data.
- `GET /api/v4/user/communication_preferences` — Get user communication preferences.
- `GET /api/v4/ztx-bff/users/{userId}` — Retrieve user information by user ID.
- `GET /one/static/onetrust/consent/{consentId}/{consentId}/en.json` — Retrieve OneTrust consent configuration data (English).
- `GET /one/static/onetrust/scripttemplates/202411.1.0/assets/otFlat.json` — Retrieve OneTrust script template assets (otFlat.json).
- `GET /one/static/onetrust/scripttemplates/202411.1.0/assets/v2/otPcTab.json` — Retrieve OneTrust script template assets (otPcTab.json).
- `GET /one/version.json` — Get the current version of the one-dash-cloudflare application.

### Data Write (2)
- `POST /api/gates/api/v1/runtime/assignments` — Submit runtime assignments to the gates API.
- `POST /sentry/envelope` — Send error and event data to Sentry for monitoring.

### Config (1)
- `GET /api/v4/system/bootstrap` — Retrieve system bootstrap configuration.

### Core API (1)
- `GET /api/v4/{v4Id}` — Access a core API endpoint (requires v4Id).

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to One Dash Cloudflare's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access One Dash Cloudflare data without official API access
- Automate actions on one.dash.cloudflare.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the One Dash Cloudflare frontend uses
